scope: Automatic Zombie Boss Remaining enrichment without per-row clicking and without exceeding the owner's 90-second normal-scan ceiling

boundedReproduction: Use tools/run_live_resource_probe.py package reader and verified LENC decoder to extract the named current-v18 Lua chunk from the exact package hash.
Parse the decoded Lua 5.3 chunk with the Reader/decode helpers in tools/inspect_uimain_world_transition.py.
Locate constants MonsterInvasionBoss, MonsterInvasionBossDetail, OnGetDetail, GetMonsterProtectionEndTime and inspect their containing prototypes and call operands.
Run the ordinary live proof with: dotnet run --project tests\LWBridge.Desktop.Checks\LWBridge.Desktop.Checks.csproj -c Release --no-build -- --live-current-client-full-monster-manual

implementation.acquisition: Each exact MonsterInvasionBoss is requested while its AOI is loaded; UUIDs are deduplicated and bound to profile, launch session, challenge, game PID, scan run and server.
implementation.pacing: No per-boss or per-AOI response timeout is allowed to fail base acquisition. The host keeps only boss-bearing AOIs stable for at most 100 ms and the Lua pump may retry an unanswered UUID once after 40 ms.
implementation.collection: One post-acquisition collector waits once for outstanding responses, validates exact run identity and target cardinality, then merges only received isProtected/protectionEndTime values.
implementation.failurePolicy: Transport timeout or malformed enrichment is fail-soft for the optional detail: the complete Monster scan publishes, Remaining stays unknown, stale zMBossInfo is not substituted, and diagnostics retain target/request/retry/ready/error counts.
implementation.presentation: Received isProtected=true with positive protectionEndTime populates shieldEndTime and the existing Remaining countdown; received inactive, unanswered, nonpositive or expired values render '-'.
implementation.implementationPolicy: The 100 ms host settle and one 40 ms unanswered retry are rebuild pacing choices measured against the owner's under-90-second requirement, not recovered LWBridge constants.
